faq.q: Will it work on my device?
faq.a: Contact support with your device model and version. Use a trial to check compatibility before paying.

faq.q: Which channels are available in my country?
faq.a: Ask support to confirm available content for your country. Availability may vary by region and plan.
Quality depends on the source, device, application and connection speed. Test streaming on your device during a trial.

faq.q: How many devices can stream at the same time?
faq.a: Confirm the permitted number of simultaneous connections with support before subscribing.

faq.q: How do I pay, and does the plan renew automatically?
faq.a: Ask support about payment methods, renewal and refund terms before paying. A plan button opens WhatsApp and does not charge you.
